title: Probability and statistics
learning_outcomes: Explain probability and events in the context of probability and statistics.
Compare and distinguish descriptive statistics in the context of probability and statistics.
Apply sampling bias in the context of probability and statistics.
Evaluate and justify decisions about base rates in the context of probability and statistics.

lessons.title: Probability and events
lessons.outcome: Explain probability and events in the context of probability and statistics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving probability and events; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Create an annotated explanation with a concrete example and a counterexample. Connect the result to worked probability and survey critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain probability and events from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of probability and events; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Descriptive statistics
lessons.outcome: Compare and distinguish descriptive statistics in the context of probability and statistics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving descriptive statistics; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Compare two cases or approaches using explicit criteria; identify an important limitation. Connect the result to worked probability and survey critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain descriptive statistics from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of descriptive statistics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Sampling bias
lessons.outcome: Apply sampling bias in the context of probability and statistics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving sampling bias; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Work through a new case or simulation; document assumptions and steps. Connect the result to worked probability and survey critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain sampling bias from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of sampling bias; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

lessons.title: Base rates
lessons.outcome: Evaluate and justify decisions about base rates in the context of probability and statistics.
lessons.worked_example_brief: Use a realistic fictional case involving base rates; show reasoning, a contrasting case and limitations.
lessons.practice: Analyse an unfamiliar case; defend a choice, identify uncertainty and revise after feedback. Connect the result to worked probability and survey critique.
lessons.knowledge_check: Explain base rates from memory and apply it to a different example; state one limitation.
lessons.evidence_criterion: Accurate explanation of base rates; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

criteria.criterion: Accurate explanation of probability and events; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of descriptive statistics; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of sampling bias; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.
Accurate explanation of base rates; correct application to a new case; clear rationale and limits.

assessment.threshold: All mapped criteria at level 2; no averaging away missing criteria. Level 3 requires independent novel application, delayed reassessment and appropriate review.
assessment.alternate_evidence: Equivalent accessible written, oral, visual, simulated or supervised evidence; no personal disclosure required.
assessment.reviewer: Education, statistics or philosophy specialist as relevant.

safety.notes: Respect consent, privacy and applicable rules; source and subject review before publication.
